sentences.en: Thylacines used to live in Australia before they became extinct.
sentences.zh: 袋狼以前生活在澳大利亚，但在灭绝之前它们已经不在了。

sentences.en: How do you think humans are going to become extinct?
sentences.zh: 你怎么认为人类会灭绝？

sentences.en: If something isn't done, this species will soon go extinct.
sentences.zh: 如果不采取措施，这种物种很快就会灭绝。
